title: Dragon's Gaze
description: A large orange dragon with pink eyes and colorful paint splatters lies curled in the background behind a wooden fence, gazing toward the foreground. In the foreground, a woman's severed head with brown hair rests on a stone path as a bright beam of light shines from the dragon's eye onto it, with a small brown horse standing nearby between blue trees.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a massive vibrant orange dragon with textured scales and large pink eyes lying behind a wooden fence in a forest, colorful paint splatters of pink yellow and blue cover the dragon and trees, a small brown horse stands in the midground, in the foreground on a stone path lies a woman's severed head with brown hair and realistic features, a bright beam of light shines from the dragon's eye directly onto the head, painterly style with visible brush strokes and bold colors
